sanity_expectations: C(0) = 0 and increases monotonically at very short times (build-up phase)
C reaches a transient peak within the first ~5 s then decays as D accumulates
E and L decrease from their initial values (0.5 and 2.0 uM) monotonically at early times as C+D grows
D(0) = 0 and D(t) is monotone non-decreasing over the window (only source is closing_rate*C plus gated closure; opening_rate*D subtracts but is small at k_off=0.1)
Mass balance approximately holds: E + C + D approx const = 0.5 uM (enzyme is limiting) up to numerical tolerance
Diffusive-enhancement contribution to dC/dt is largest at t -> 0 and decays as 1/sqrt(t) for large t
excitation_report: Full-system child vs parent trajectory comparison over t in [0.001, 30] s with sigma=0.01 uM. The new diffusive-encounter term diffusive_encounter_enhancement_fraction*association_rate*E*L/sqrt(1 + diffusive_boundary_relaxation_rate*t) shifts the C(t) trajectory by up to 0.114 uM ~ 11.4*sigma, strongest near t ~ 0.30 s (short-time regime as expected). All prior terms remain active on the same trajectory (association/dissociation/isomerization dominate ~1-10 uM/s scale; stretched-exponential mixing deficit, gated closure, and cage-rebinding all contribute at O(0.1-1) uM/s over the window). Passes 5*sigma visibility test.

rationale: Contract inherited verbatim (ode_system, 4 states, target C, integrator integrate_system). Time window 0-30 s follows the phenomenon description ("first 30 seconds"); 400 linearly-spaced points give dense early-time coverage where both the stretched-exponential mixing deficit and the new 1/sqrt(1+g*t) diffusive enhancement are active. Parameter magnitudes were chosen so the association flux k_on*E*L ~ 1 uM/s dominates and every subterm sits in a physically reasonable range: k_on=1 (uM/s)^-1, k_off=2/s (fast encounter dissociation), k_close=0.5/s, k_open=0.1/s, gated_closing_rate=1/s, cage_escape=10/s vs cage_rebind=1 giving a modest ~20% cage-rebinding correction, stretched exponents 0.7-0.8 (typical of heterogeneous protein relaxation). The new-term amplitude diffusive_encounter_enhancement_fraction=1.5 sits mid-range in [0.01, 3] and diffusive_boundary_relaxation_rate=5/s (mid-range on a log scale in [0.1, 10000]) makes the enhancement decay over ~200 ms, exactly the short-time window this experiment probes. Noise sigma=0.01 uM is 1% of the enzyme scale; excitation_check confirms the new term reaches 11.4*sigma on the target trajectory.
